audience: recruiters and hiring managers who manage job vacancies and applications in Homerun

useCases.title: List your vacancies and check which are published
useCases.text: The AI lists job vacancies with title, status (draft, private, public), type, location type and expiry. It can include location, department and hiring stages.

useCases.title: See the hiring stages and candidate count of a vacancy
useCases.text: The AI opens a vacancy with its hiring stages, salary indication, candidate count and the public job and application-form URLs.

useCases.title: Review applications and their current stage
useCases.text: The AI lists applications with name, vacancy, current stage, rating and hired dates and disqualified status, and opens one in full with contact details, experience and education.

useCases.title: Read the notes and tags on an application
useCases.text: The AI lists the notes on one application with author and text, and the tags attached to it. It can sum up what the hiring team wrote.

useCases.title: Move an application to a stage or add a note
useCases.text: The AI moves one application to another hiring stage of its vacancy, or adds one note that the hiring team can see. Notes cannot be removed with this server.
